story_text: As a user, I want the forgot-password endpoint to require the email field so that incomplete requests are rejected.

positive.title: Accept forgot-password request when email field is provided
steps: 1. Send a forgot-password request to the endpoint.
2. Include a valid registered email in the request payload.
positive.expected_result: The system accepts the request and proceeds with the password reset process.

positive.title: Send password reset link when valid email is submitted
steps: 1. Send a forgot-password request to the endpoint.
2. Provide a valid registered email address.
4. Check the email inbox for the reset link.
positive.expected_result: A password reset link is sent to the provided email address.

negative.title: Reject request with invalid email
steps: 1. Send a forgot-password request to the endpoint.
2. Provide an invalid email format (e.g., userexample.com).
negative.expected_result: The system rejects the request and returns an error indicating invalid email format.

negative.title: Return incorrect error message for missing email field
steps: 1. Send a forgot-password request to the endpoint.
2. Omit the email field from the request payload.
negative.expected_result: The system returns an error indicating that the email field is required.

edge.title: Submit forgot-password request with email field as empty string via API
steps: 1. Send a forgot-password request to the endpoint via API.
2. Set the email field to an empty string ("").
edge.expected_result: The system rejects the request and returns an error indicating that the email field cannot be empty.
